title: A zone's NPC info cache: res/field/actors/npc_caches/<n>.json
description: File n of ARCID_FIELD_ACTOR_CONFIG (a/0/5/7), which a zone's header names by its npc_cache (res/field/zones/; GetZoneNPCInfoCacheIdx) and LoadMModelSystemInfoCache loads as the player enters the zone (event_mapchange.c), or none for a number from 24 on. GetNPCMdlInfoForOBJCODE takes a code's record from the cache before it reads the model table (field_actor.c). tools/data/npc_cache_data.py packs the caches in order, each with a copy of its codes' records, written from their data.json in res/field/actors/.

codes.description: The object codes the cache holds, at most 26 to fit its 0x310 bytes; GetNPCMdlInfoForOBJCODE reads a cache only when it holds fewer than 26 (CONFIG_CACHE_MAX)
